notes.title: Exciting Update: Farcaster Approved for App Lab on Meta Oculus Quest 2 and Pro!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

I've got some fantastic news for all of you who've been following the development of our VR action-arcade shooter, Farcaster. We're thrilled to announce that Farcaster has just been approved for App Lab on Meta Oculus Quest 2 and Pro! 🎉

This means that soon, all of you Meta Oculus Quest 2 and Pro users will be able to experience the fast-paced, immersive gameplay of Farcaster, where you play as a daring gunslinger navigating action-packed worlds on a floating platform and taking down enemies with your trusty revolvers.

We'll keep you posted on the official release date and any other exciting updates. In the meantime, feel free to ask any questions or share your thoughts in the comments below. We always appreciate your input and enjoy connecting with fellow VR enthusiasts and gamers!

Thank you for your ongoing support, and we can't wait to bring Farcaster to your Meta Oculus Quest 2 and Pro headsets!
